slots.name: fighting status
slots.sentence: Addis Ababa has in turn accused Eritrea, Sudan and Egypt of supporting an opposition alliance led by the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) that has fought against troops loyal to Ethiopia’s federal government since last week.

slots.name: frontier length
slots.sentence: The federal army is clearly providing full support to the TPF, yet the original TPLF still holds several towns, he said, but maintains a strong link with Eritrea along more than 800 kilometres of frontier.

slots.name: casualties
slots.sentence: Hundreds have been killed and wounded since last week's resumption of heavy fighting in northern Ethiopia.

slots.name: start date
slots.sentence: Tigrayan-led rebel forces have engaged in clashes with Ethiopian government-backed forces in the country’s north since last week.

slots.name: fighting locations
slots.sentence: Fighting is concentrated in three regions: Tigray, Amhara and Afar.

slots.name: territorial control status
slots.sentence: forces loyal to the federal government have made significant gains in the Tigray region, taking control of several towns and closing in on the regional capital, Mekelle.

slots.name: armed groups
slots.sentence: In the last two weeks, the TPLF and six other armed groups in Ethiopia have fought the government in Tigray and the neighbouring regions Amhara and Afar.

slots.name: recruitment age
slots.sentence: While the full impact of the fighting on Tigrayan civilians is not clear, reports have emerged of the TPLF forcibly recruiting boys as young as 15 to fight.

events.label: African Union reports Tigrayan airport seizures

slots.name: airports seized
slots.sentence: The African Union reported last month that Tigrayan forces had seized airports in Mekelle, Axum and Shire and detained federal personnel, disrupting civilian air services.

events.label: Seven groups announce Ethiopian opposition alliance

slots.name: alliance groups
slots.sentence: Seven armed and political groups announced an alliance on September 20 aimed at removing Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s administration and establishing an inclusive transitional government.

events.label: TPF claims near-full control of Tigray
Ethiopian officials accuse neighbors of backing Tigray alliance

slots.name: countries accused
slots.sentence: Ethiopian military officials have accused Eritrea, Egypt and Sudan of supporting the Tigrayan-led fighting alliance.

slots.name: denial status
slots.sentence: Eritrea and Egypt have denied accusations that they are backing efforts to destabilise Ethiopia.

slots.name: countries expelling diplomats
slots.sentence: That has led to tit-for-tat expulsions of diplomats between Ethiopia, Eritrea and Egypt.

events.label: Tigray humanitarian conditions worsen amid renewed fighting

slots.name: regional population
slots.sentence: Some civilians, fearing the fighting could move into major urban centres, have already begun fleeing to Amhara and Afar, he reported.

events.label: Ethiopian army advances toward Tigray capital
Tigray students relocated due to conflict

slots.name: relocated students
slots.sentence: Due to the ongoing fighting in Ethiopia's Tigray region, some 5,000 students who asked to be relocated are now starting the academic year far from home.

events.label: Eritrean troops reported in Ethiopia's Tigray region

slots.name: entry distance
slots.sentence: Military vehicles carrying soldiers drove across Eritrea’s southern border into Tigray on Wednesday, reaching the town of Adigrat 25 miles (40km) south, according to civilian witnesses, a militia commander and the conflict monitoring group Acled.

events.label: Tigray Peace Force imposes overnight curfew in Mekelle

slots.name: curfew status
slots.sentence: The Tigray Peace Force, which includes former members of the TPLF’s armed wing, imposed an overnight curfew Wednesday.

events.label: Drones target Eritrean troops inside Ethiopia

slots.name: attack periods
slots.sentence: Eritrean troops were then targeted by Ethiopian government drones on Wednesday evening and Thursday morning, Acled said.

events.label: Ethiopian federal police patrol Mekelle after TPLF withdrawal

slots.name: administration status
slots.sentence: Tigray’s television and radio stations have been off the air since the TPLF withdrawal.

slots.name: broadcast status
slots.sentence: It also outlined plans to register people involved in the conflict and help them return to civilian life.
